# simplelogin_domain (Data Source)

Reads a custom domain of the SimpleLogin account by name. Read-only: domains cannot be created or changed with this provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplelogin_domain" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

output "example_domain_verified" {
  value = data.simplelogin_domain.example.is_verified
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name, e.g. `example.com` (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `catch_all` (Boolean) Whether catch-all (auto-create aliases on first email) is enabled.
- `id` (Number) SimpleLogin custom domain ID.
- `is_verified` (Boolean) Whether domain ownership (MX) is verified. Aliases can only be created on verified domains.
- `mailbox_ids` (Set of Number) Default mailboxes for catch-all aliases on this domain.
- `name` (String) Default display name for aliases on this domain, or null.
- `random_prefix_generation` (Boolean) Whether random prefix generation is enabled for the domain.
